newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: SOCCER-CHILAVERT'S ACROBATICS EARN PARAGUAY WORLD CUP POINT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHILAVERT'S ACROBATICS EARN PARAGUAY WORLD CUP POINT.

text.p: Paraguay goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert, who usually makes headlines by scoring goals, showed more orthodox skills on Sunday to earn his team a 0-0 draw away to Bolivia in a World Cup qualifier.
Chilavert made a series of saves to keep the Bolivian attack at bay.
The extrovert goalkeeper, who has scored nine goals this year from free kicks and penalties, also had one free kick attempt in the 39th minute but fired his shot way wide of the goal.
Chilavert was beaten twice but was saved by the woodwork on each occasion, leaving Bolivia to lament two more dropped home points.
Bolivia, who have a huge home advantage because they play at 3,600 metres above sea level, have managed only draws in their last three home games and have lost their two away matches.
Paraguay, who began the day in second place in the single South American World Cup qualifying group, arrived an unprecedented three weeks before the game to acclimatise.
